description: Reference-script + inline-datum phase-2 differential (cardano 11.1.2 vs amaru 0925). Spends pre-mined script UTxOs; reference-script resolution (witness vs reference must agree), inline-vs-datum-hash, script-fail is_valid paths, wrong reference script. Verdict + reason-class parity; fail-closed.

cases.note: spend inline-datum script UTxO, script in WITNESS -> accept (baseline)
same spend, script via REFERENCE (C_ok) -> accept; MUST equal spendA-witness (reference-script resolution)
spend datum-HASH UTxO, datum SUPPLIED, script in witness -> accept
spend datum-HASH UTxO via reference script, datum supplied -> accept
spend datum-HASH UTxO with datum OMITTED -> both reject (missing datum)
spend always-FAILS UTxO, is_valid=true -> script fails -> both reject (tag mismatch)
spend always-FAILS UTxO, is_valid=false -> claim matches -> both accept (collateral consumed)
spend always-succeeds UTxO but provide C_fail as the reference script (hash != addr) -> both reject (script mismatch); must NOT run the wrong script
C_ok used as spending reference script AND as a read-only reference input -> both accept (dedup/disjointness edge)
